title: CT Special Forces

widgets.text: Pick one of two commandos per mission; both play the same. Hostages freed give points.
Missions alternate side-scrolling shooting, sniping and helicopter sections. Bosses are usually vehicles: stay out of their straight firing lines and use rockets.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Four theatres of operations (jungle, Asia, desert, Arctic), each a series of short missions with a password at the end.
Rescue the hostages in each level for a better mission score.
Passwords are shown after each completed mission; note them to continue.
